legislation.notes: Highest U.S. plug-in cap: 1,920 W of output to the electric grid per address, per the definition at 40-2-140(1)(e)(I). A device of 391 W or less is additionally exempt under 40-2-140(5). Delayed to 1 January 2027: (6) sale of a device above 391 W that is not UL labelled and listed is prohibited; (7) covenants unreasonably prohibiting a device are void and a property owner may impose reasonable restrictions.
legislation.effective_note: SECTION 6 of the act: takes effect ninety days after final adjournment, stated in the act as 12 August 2026. Subsections 40-2-140(6) and (7) are delayed to 1 January 2027 - see notes. A richer structure for the delayed provisions and the 391 W tier is proposed but not yet applied.
